entries.name: rblock.aspect.ratio
entries.description: Get the rigid block aspect ratio. This is the ratio of the longest to the shortest dimension of the tightest fitting object aligned bounding box.

entries.name: rblock.axis.angle
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block orientation. This is taken from an axis-angle representation. This value is incremented during cycling, and can be reset.

entries.name: rblock.axis.angle.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block orientation.

entries.name: rblock.axis.angle.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the rigid block orientation.

entries.name: rblock.axis.long
entries.description: Get the direction of the longest axis of the rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.ball.pos
entries.description: Get the rigid block ball position. This is the position of the minimum enclosing {circle in 2D; sphere in 3D} with radius rblock.ball.radius.

entries.name: rblock.ball.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the rigid block ball position.

entries.name: rblock.ball.radius
entries.description: Get the rigid block ball radius. This is the radius of the minimum enclosing {circle in 2D; sphere in 3D} centered at the position rblock.ball.pos.

entries.name: rblock.contact.list
entries.description: Get active contacts around a rblock. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a rigid block. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.contactmap
entries.description: Get active contacts around a rblock. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all contacts around a rigid block. Inactive contacts are included. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.contactnum
entries.description: Get number of active contacts around a rblock. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: rblock.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get number of contacts around a rblock. Inactive contacts are included. The optional argument enables filtering by contact type.

entries.name: rblock.containing
entries.description: Find the rigid block containing the point. The core shapes are used to determine if the point falls within the rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.convergence
entries.description: Return the rigid block convergence. The convergence is the ratio of the current local force ratio (rblock.ratio) to the target force ratio (rblock.ratio.target). A value of 1 or less is considered “converged”.

entries.name: rblock.copy
entries.description: Copy a rigid block. All data is copied to a new rigid block and a pointer to the new rigid block is returned. The original rigid block remains.

entries.name: rblock.damp
entries.description: Get/set rigid block local damping factor.

entries.name: rblock.delete
entries.description: Delete a rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.density
entries.description: Get/set rigid block density.

entries.name: rblock.disp
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block displacement.

entries.name: rblock.disp.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block displacement.

entries.name: rblock.energy
entries.description: Get the rigid block total energy contribution. This is the sum over all rigid blocks of the energy with name s (see the model energy command). Available energies are: energy-body, energy-damp, and energy-kinetic.

entries.name: rblock.euler
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block orientation.

entries.name: rblock.euler.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block orientation.

entries.name: rblock.extra
entries.description: Get/set rigid block extra variable.

entries.name: rblock.facet.area
entries.description: Get the rigid block facet area. This corresponds to the {length of the linear facet in 2D; area of the triangular facet in 3D}. If rounding is present the core shape facet area is returned. i can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num.

entries.name: rblock.facet.centroid
entries.description: Get the facet centroid. if can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. The facets correspond to the entries returned by rblock.facet.map and rblock.vertex.map.

entries.name: rblock.facet.centroid.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the facet centroid. if can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. The facets correspond to the entries returned by rblock.facet.map and rblock.vertex.map.

entries.name: rblock.facet.closest
entries.description: Get the closest point on a facet. The closest point on facet if to the point in space vp is returned. if can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. The facets correspond to the entries returned by rblock.facet.map and rblock.vertex.map.

entries.name: rblock.facet.closest.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the closest point on a facet.

entries.name: rblock.facet.group
entries.description: Get/set rigid block facet groups.

entries.name: rblock.facet.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the rigid block facet i and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: rblock.facet.list
entries.description: Get the facet list. Each entry is an integer into the vertex list returned by rblock.vertex.list. Each consecutive {two in 2D; three in 3D} entries, starting from the beginning of the list, define a facet.

entries.name: rblock.facet.map
entries.description: Get the facet map. Each entry is an integer into the vertex map returned by rblock.vertex.map. Each consecutive {two in 2D; three in 3D} entries, starting from the beginning of the map, define a facet.

entries.name: rblock.facet.normal
entries.description: Get the facet normal. if can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. The facets correspond to the entries returned by rblock.facet.map and rblock.vertex.map.

entries.name: rblock.facet.normal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the facet normal. if can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. The facets correspond to the entries returned by rblock.facet.map and rblock.vertex.map.

entries.name: rblock.facet.num
entries.description: Get the facet count.

entries.name: rblock.facet.vertex.pos
entries.description: Get the facet vertex position. if, the facet number, can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. iv, the vertex of the facet, can take values {1 or 2 in 2D; 1, 2 or 3 in 3D}.

entries.name: rblock.facet.vertex.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the facet vertex position. if, the facet number, can take values from 1 to rblock.facet.num. iv, the vertex of the facet, can take values {1 or 2 in 2D; 1, 2 or 3 in 3D}.

entries.name: rblock.find
entries.description: Find a rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.fix
entries.description: Get/set rigid block fixity condition.

entries.name: rblock.force.app
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block applied force.

entries.name: rblock.force.app.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block applied force.

entries.name: rblock.force.contact
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block contact force.

entries.name: rblock.force.contact.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block contact force.

entries.name: rblock.force.unbal
entries.description: Get the rigid block unbalanced force.

entries.name: rblock.force.unbal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the rigid block unbalanced force.

entries.name: rblock.fragment
entries.description: Get/set rigid block fragment ID. See the “Fragment” section for further details.

entries.name: rblock.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to rigid block b in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: rblock.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of rigid blocks that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices*. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: rblock.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the rigid block in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: rblock.groupmap
entries.description: Get rigid blocks that belong to a group.

entries.name: rblock.id
entries.description: Get the rigid block ID.

entries.name: rblock.inbox
entries.description: Get rigid blocks with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the rblock. Specifying b = false indicates that only rigid blocks with positions falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: rblock.inglobal
entries.description: Rotate a vector from principal system. The returned vector is in the global axis system.

entries.name: rblock.inprin
entries.description: Rotate a vector to principal system.

entries.name: rblock.inside
entries.description: Test whether a point is inside a rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.intersect
entries.description: Get the intersection status of two rigid blocks.

entries.name: rblock.isbonded
entries.description: Get the rigid block bonded state. This intrinsic checks the contact models of all active contacts with the rigid block for bonding. The optional arguments enable filtering by contact type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the rigid block and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: rblock.isprop
entries.description: Query the existence of a property.

entries.name: rblock.length.max
entries.description: Return the rigid block maximum length. The aspect ratio computation provides a set of axes aligned with the rigid block maximum and minimum dimensions. The maximum length is the maximum dimension.

entries.name: rblock.length.min
entries.description: Return the rigid block minimum length. The aspect ratio computation provides a set of axes aligned with the rigid block maximum and minimum dimensions. The minimum length is the minimum dimension.

entries.name: rblock.list
entries.description: Get the global rigid block list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: rblock.mass
entries.description: Get the inertial rigid block mass.

entries.name: rblock.mass.real
entries.description: Get the real (gravitational) rigid block mass.

entries.name: rblock.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum rigid block ID.

entries.name: rblock.mech.convergence
entries.description: Return the rigid block convergence.

entries.name: rblock.mech.ratio.avg
entries.description: Get the rigid block average unbalanced force ratio.

entries.name: rblock.mech.ratio.local
entries.description: Get the rigid block maximum local unbalanced force ratio.

entries.name: rblock.mech.ratio.max
entries.description: Get the rigid block maximum unbalanced force ratio.

entries.name: rblock.mech.unbal.max
entries.description: Get the rigid block maximum unbalanced force.

entries.name: rblock.moi
entries.description: Get the rigid block moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.fix
entries.description: Get/set the moment of inertia fixity state.

entries.name: rblock.moi.prin
entries.description: Get the rigid block principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.prin.real
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block real principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.prin.real.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block real principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.prin.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the rigid block principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.real
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block real moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.real.xx
entries.description: Get/set the xx-value of the rigid block real moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moi.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-value of the rigid block moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.moment.app
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block applied moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.app.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block applied moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.app.z
entries.description: Get/set the z-component of the rigid block applied moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.contact
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block contact moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.contact.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block contact moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.unbal
entries.description: Get the rigid block unbalanced moment.

entries.name: rblock.moment.unbal.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the rigid block unbalanced moment.

entries.name: rblock.near
entries.description: Find the closest rigid block to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: rblock.num
entries.description: Get the number of rigid blocks.

entries.name: rblock.pos
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block position.

entries.name: rblock.pos.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block position.

entries.name: rblock.prin.axis.angle
entries.description: Get the orientation of the principal axis. This is given in the axis-angle representation. This orientation cannot be reset.

entries.name: rblock.prin.axis.angle.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the axis-angle orientation of the principal axis.

entries.name: rblock.prin.euler
entries.description: Get the orientation of the principal axis. This orientation cannot be reset. The convention \big\{X,Y^{'},Z^{''}\big\} is used (i.e., the x-, y-, and z-components correspond to the sequential rotations about the X, Y^{'}, and Z^{''} axes).

entries.name: rblock.prin.euler.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the principal axis.

entries.name: rblock.prop
entries.description: Get/set a rigid block property. The function rblock.isprop can be used to assess the existence of a property.

entries.name: rblock.ratio
entries.description: Return the rigid block convergence ratio. This is the ratio of unbalanced force to force applied to the rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.ratio.target
entries.description: Get/set the target mechanical force ratio. The default value is 1e-4. A local force ratio (rblock.ratio) below this value is considered converged. See rblock.convergence.

entries.name: rblock.rounding
entries.description: Get the rigid block rounding. This is the radius of the {circle in 2D; sphere in 3D} passed over the core shape that defines the rigid block surface.

entries.name: rblock.scalesphere
entries.description: Scale the rigid block to an equivalent sphere.

entries.name: rblock.scalevol
entries.description: Scale the rigid block. The rigid block is scaled so that its {volume per unit thickness in 2D; volume in 3D} is f. The pebbles are scaled, their positions are modified, and the volume is updated.

entries.name: rblock.spin
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block angular velocity.

entries.name: rblock.spin.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block angular velocity.

entries.name: rblock.stress
entries.description: Get the stress tensor arising from all contacts acting on the rblock. The stress tensor is computed as:

entries.name: rblock.stress.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-value of the stress.

entries.name: rblock.template.delete
entries.description: Delete a rigid block template.

entries.name: rblock.template.find
entries.description: Find a rigid block template.

entries.name: rblock.template.list
entries.description: Get the global rigid block template list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: rblock.template.maxid
entries.description: Get the maximum rigid block template ID.

entries.name: rblock.template.moi
entries.description: Get the rigid block template moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.template.moi.prin
entries.description: Get the rigid block template principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.template.moi.prin.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the rigid block template principal moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.template.moi.xx
entries.description: Get the xx-value of the rigid block template moment of inertia.

entries.name: rblock.template.name
entries.description: Get the rigid block template name.

entries.name: rblock.template.num
entries.description: Get the number of rigid block templates.

entries.name: rblock.template.typeid
entries.description: Get the rigid block template type number. The typeid can be used to uniquely identify rigid block template FISH pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: rblock.template.vol
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block template volume. In 2D, this is the volume per unit thickness.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contact.list
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal rigid block. The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contact.list.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal rigid block. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contactmap
entries.description: Get active thermal contacts around a thermal rigid block. The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contactmap.all
entries.description: Get all thermal contacts around a thermal rigid block. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional arguments enable filtering by contacting piece type and/or contacting piece pointer.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contactnum
entries.description: Get number of active thermal contacts around a thermal rblock. The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.contactnum.all
entries.description: Get total number of thermal contacts around a thermal rigid block. (Inactive thermal contacts are included.) The optional argument enables filtering by contacting piece type.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.expansion
entries.description: Get/set the thermal-expansion coefficient.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.extra
entries.description: Get/set the thermal rigid block extra variable.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.find
entries.description: Find a thermal rigid block.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.fix
entries.description: Get/set the temperature fixity condition.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.group
entries.description: Get/set the group name assigned to thermal rigid block b in slot slot, if provided. The slot named 'Default' is used by default if slot is not provided.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.group.list
entries.description: Get a list of thermal rigid blocks that belong to the group named s. The arguments s and slot may be specified as strings or indices*. If slot is not specified, then all slots are queried.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.group.remove
entries.description: Remove the group s from the thermal rigid block in any slot. The removal of s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.groupmap
entries.description: Get thermal rigid blocks that belong to a group.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.id
entries.description: Get the thermal rigid block ID.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.inbox
entries.description: Get thermal rigid blocks with extents intersecting a box. The extent is the axis-aligned bounding box of the thermal rigid block. Specifying b = false indicates that only thermal rigid blocks with centroids falling in the box are returned.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.isgroup
entries.description: Check if the group s is associated with the thermal rigid block and return true if a match is found in any slot. The check for s will only occur in slot, if provided.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.isprop
entries.description: Query the existence of a property.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.list
entries.description: Get the global thermal rigid block list. Use the loop foreach construct to iterate through the list.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.near
entries.description: Find the closest thermal rigid block to a point. If frad is specified, then the search radius is limited.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.num
entries.description: Get the number of thermal rigid blocks.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.power.app
entries.description: Get/set the thermal applied power.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.power.unbal
entries.description: Get the unbalanced thermal power.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.prop
entries.description: Get/set a thermal rigid block property. The function rblock.thermal.isprop can be used to assess the existence of a property.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.specific.heat
entries.description: Get/set the specific heat coefficient.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.temp
entries.description: Get/set the temperature.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.temp.increment
entries.description: Get/set the current temperature increment.

entries.name: rblock.thermal.typeid
entries.description: Get the thermal rigid block type number. The type ID can be used to uniquely identify rigid block FISH pointers and distinguish them from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: rblock.typeid
entries.description: Get the rigid block type number. The typeid can be used to uniquely identify rigid block FISH pointers from any other type of FISH pointer.

entries.name: rblock.unbond
entries.description: Remove bonds with the rblock. All contacts are queried and the cotact bond state is set to unbonded.

entries.name: rblock.vel
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block velocity.

entries.name: rblock.vel.x
entries.description: Get/set the x-component of the rigid block velocity.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.list
entries.description: Get the vertex list. Each entry in the list is the position of a facet vertex.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.map
entries.description: Get the vertex map. Each entry in the map is the position of a facet vertex.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.near
entries.description: Get the vertex nearest to v.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.num
entries.description: Get the vertex count.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.pos
entries.description: Get the vertex position. i can take values from 1 to rblock.vertex.num.

entries.name: rblock.vertex.pos.x
entries.description: Get the x-component of the vertex position. i can take values from 1 to rblock.vertex.num.

entries.name: rblock.vol
entries.description: Get/set the rigid block volume. In 2D, this is the volume per unit thickness.
